gloss: start of sales; launch; going on sale

definitions.gloss: start of sales; launch; going on sale; release
definitions.explanation: The beginning of selling a product to the public. Used for commercial product releases, ticket sales, and other sales events.

examples.japanese: ⟦{本日|ほんじつ}→本日：09643_honjitsu⟧{発売|はつばい}{開始|かいし}。
⟦{新商品|しんしょうひん}→新商品：11504_shinshouhin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{発売|はつばい}{開始|かいし}{日|び}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まった→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧。
examples.english: The launch date for the new product has been decided.

examples.japanese: ⟦チケット→チケット：11014_chiketto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{発売|はつばい}{開始|かいし}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{同時|どうじ}→同時：01592_douji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{数分|すうふん}→数分：21623_suufun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{完売|かんばい}→完売：18954_kanbai⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧しまった。
examples.english: The tickets sold out within minutes of going on sale.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{発売|はつばい}→発売：04315_hatsubai⟧ (sale, release) and ⟦{開始|かいし}→開始：02537_kaishi⟧ (start, beginning). Very commonly seen in advertising and product announcements.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {発売|はつばい}{開始|かいし}{日|び}: release date; launch date
- {発売|はつばい}{開始|かいし}{時刻|じこく}: sale start time
- {発売|はつばい}{開始|かいし}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to start selling; to launch
- ⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧{発売|はつばい}{開始|かいし}: start of pre-order sales

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{発売|はつばい}→発売：04315_hatsubai⟧: release; sale — the broader term; ⟦{開始|かいし}→開始：02537_kaishi⟧ specifies the starting point
- ⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧⟦{開始|かいし}→開始：02537_kaishi⟧: start of sales — very similar but ⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧ is more general (ongoing selling) while ⟦{発売|はつばい}→発売：04315_hatsubai⟧ emphasizes the initial release
- ⟦{発売|はつばい}{日|び}→発売日：10160_hatsubaibi⟧: release date — the specific date, without emphasizing the act of beginning

REGISTER:
Neutral. Extremely common in advertising, marketing, and news about product releases.
